---
title: "Stores"
---

Every registered Store Release and its state: its Release Status, its Store
Layout, its Association Coverage, the counts its Validation Record observed, and
whether the current Analysis Catalog version lists it. A count the record left
`null` stays `not reported`, and a total over such a column is
`unknown (k of n Stores report it)` rather than a partial sum.

**This page is generated at render time** by
[`src/project_site/pages.py`](../src/project_site/pages.py) from the Release
Bundles under `stores/` and the collected catalog versions, with one page per
Store beside it; the render replaces this file. Run `pixi run site-data` and then
`pixi run site` to see it.

The registry itself is the record: one directory per Store Release under
`stores/`, and [`../STORES.md`](../STORES.md) is the generated index of them.
